conf.comment:
suricata to OCSF#NETWORK pipeline.
Parses events, drops noise, maps to OCSF#NETWORK schema, and outputs compact JSON.

functions.description: Parse Suricata EVE JSON log into structured fields
Normalize timestamp, protocol, and network address field names
Derive action, dst_host, and message fields for DNS events
Set action for non-DNS Suricata event types
Alias captured timestamp field(s) to log_time (_time) so _time reflects the source event, not pipeline processing time

conf.comment: --- STEP 2: Map fields to OCSF#NETWORK schema ---

add.name: src_ip
add.value: src_ip || source__ip || client__ip || srcaddr || srcip || id_orig_h

add.name: dest_ip
add.value: dest_ip || dst_ip || destination__ip || server__ip || dstaddr || dstip || id_resp_h

add.name: src_port
add.value: src_port || source__port || spt || srcport || sport || id_orig_p

add.name: dest_port
add.value: dest_port || dst_port || destination__port || dpt || dstport || dport || id_resp_p

add.name: bytes_in
add.value: bytes_in || destination__bytes || rcvd_bytes || rcvdbyte || bytes_received || received_bytes || rcvd_octets || resp_bytes

add.name: bytes_out
add.value: bytes_out || source__bytes || sent_bytes || sentbyte || bytes_sent || sent_octets || orig_bytes

add.name: host
add.value: host || observer__hostname || hostname || device_hostname || device_name || dvchost || devname

add.name: log_time
add.value: log_time || generated_time || receive_time || start_time || event__created || timestamp || event__start || time || event_time || datetime || logtime

add.name: request_method
add.value: request_method || method || http_method || httpmethod || requestmethod || cs_method || verb || http_verb

functions.description: Alias Copilot/schematizer OCSF-style fields to canonical names

add.name: _time
add.value: (typeof log_time != 'undefined' && log_time) ? (/^\d{13}$/.test(String(log_time)) ? Number(log_time) : /^\d{10}$/.test(String(log_time)) ? Number(log_time) * 1000 : /^\d{13}\.\d+$/.test(String(log_time)) ? Number(log_time) : /^\d{10}\.\d+$/.test(String(log_time)) ? Number(log_time) * 1000 : new Date(String(log_time).replace(/^(\d{1,2})\/([A-Za-z]{3})\/(\d{4}):(\d{2}:\d{2}:\d{2})\s*([+-]\d{4})?$/, '$2 $1 $3 $4 $5')).getTime()) / 1000 : _time

functions.description: Set _time from the parsed timestamp (log_time), if one was captured
Create OCSF parent objects (dotted names need an existing parent)

add.name: metadata.product
add.value: metadata && metadata.product && typeof metadata.product == 'object' && !Array.isArray(metadata.product) && JSON.stringify(metadata.product) == '{}' ? undefined : metadata.product

add.name: src_endpoint
add.value: src_endpoint && typeof src_endpoint == 'object' && !Array.isArray(src_endpoint) && JSON.stringify(src_endpoint) == '{}' ? undefined : src_endpoint

add.name: metadata
add.value: metadata && typeof metadata == 'object' && !Array.isArray(metadata) && JSON.stringify(metadata) == '{}' ? undefined : metadata

add.name: dst_endpoint
add.value: dst_endpoint && typeof dst_endpoint == 'object' && !Array.isArray(dst_endpoint) && JSON.stringify(dst_endpoint) == '{}' ? undefined : dst_endpoint

add.name: connection_info
add.value: connection_info && typeof connection_info == 'object' && !Array.isArray(connection_info) && JSON.stringify(connection_info) == '{}' ? undefined : connection_info

functions.description: Drop OCSF objects that stayed empty

add.name: class_uid
add.value: class_uid != null && class_uid !== '' && Number.isFinite(Number(class_uid)) ? Number(class_uid) : class_uid

add.name: activity_id
add.value: activity_id != null && activity_id !== '' && Number.isFinite(Number(activity_id)) ? Number(activity_id) : activity_id

add.name: severity_id
add.value: class_uid != null && class_uid !== '' ? (severity_id != null && severity_id !== '' && Number.isFinite(Number(severity_id)) ? Number(severity_id) : 0) : severity_id

add.name: type_uid
add.value: class_uid != null && activity_id != null ? Number(class_uid) * 100 + Number(activity_id) : type_uid

add.name: metadata
add.value: class_uid != null && class_uid !== '' ? (metadata && typeof metadata == 'object' ? metadata : {}) : metadata

add.name: metadata.product
add.value: class_uid != null && class_uid !== '' ? (metadata.product && typeof metadata.product == 'object' ? metadata.product : {}) : (metadata && metadata.product)

add.name: time
add.value: class_uid != null && class_uid !== '' ? (typeof time == 'number' && Number.isFinite(time) && time > 0 ? (time < 100000000000 ? Math.round(time * 1000) : Math.round(time)) : (time != null && time !== '' && Number.isFinite(Number(time)) && Number(time) > 0 ? (Number(time) < 100000000000 ? Math.round(Number(time) * 1000) : Math.round(Number(time))) : (time != null && time !== '' && typeof time != 'number' && Number.isFinite(new Date(String(time)).getTime()) ? new Date(String(time)).getTime() : (_time != null && Number(_time) > 0 ? Math.round(Number(_time) * 1000) : time)))) : time

functions.description: OCSF schema grounding (P3): derive ids, create metadata, stamp metadata.version=1.9.0, normalise time
Final cleanup - remove all fields except routing fields

findings.issue: 17 attribute(s) not in the network_activity (4001) schema: timestamp, flow_id, pcap_cnt, event_type, src_ip, src_port… — carry vendor-specific data under `unmapped`.
